title: Scrollbar hit areas can be frustrating
summary: ### Reproduction steps 1. Open Zed 2. Open Zed Source Code (or any large project) 3. Open Project Panel 4. Move mouse over scroll thumb 5. Move mouse further to the right towards edge of panel 6. Can now click on item _under_ the scroll thumb --- Another Case --- 1. Move mouse over scroll thumb 2. Move mouse above scroll thumb 3. Click 4. No scrolling, no scroll bar appears ### Current vs. Expected behavior https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/34ecc752-b11e-4399-a79c-da7ecc67e6e0 I think the scroll bars should aim to work similar to how Firefox does them. - When you hover over an area that can be scrolled, the scroll thumb appears at half width, no scroll background. - When you mouse over the scroll area (so the entire height of the scroll bar and full thumb width), the scroll area becomes visible and the thumb goes to full width. - If you click anywhere in the scroll bar area, it will scroll to there. - When you mouse out from the scroll area, the thumb will return to half width. - When you mouse out of the scrollable area, the thumb eventually disappears. Here's a small demo just to remind people https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8379ef74-fbee-47c3-b31e-1bc9c0cd394a I also think that anything to the right of the scrollbar area should not be clickable, from the leftmost edge of the scroll bar (either half or full width) to the edge of the scrollable area the bar is in, nothing _behind_ the scroll bar should be clickable. I think this is the behaviour for most GUI programs, I could be wrong. But as of right now when I go to grab the thumb, if I'm a bit off, I will click off the right edge and onto a file or something _behind_ the scroll bar and maybe move it to a different location. I think people are also very used to clicking inside the entire vertical area of a scroll bar and having something happen, either scroll to where the click was OR scroll a full/half page up or down. ### Zed version and system specs Zed: v1.23.2+stable (Zed)

title: Puzzle streak "skip this move" frustrating behavior
summary: When using the one-time-only "Skip this move" button on Puzzle Streak, if it happens to be the last move of the puzzle, then you are immediately taken to the next puzzle with no way to go back. For learning purposes I'd like to be able to see the last move of the puzzle before moving on to the next one.

title: Remember camera perspective for vehicles.
summary: ### Is your feature request related to a problem (if not, explain why you think this feature should be added)? Please describe. Even with First-Person Mode active, the camera never remembers that perspective when I enter a vehicle. It's frustrating having to spam inputs to switch my camera back to FPP. ### Describe the solution you'd like Allow an option in settings that remembers player camera (between third or first-person) to be remembered when entering a vehicle. ### Describe alternatives you've considered I've considered manually switching to first-person camera every time I enter a vehicle, but this gets tedious when driving multiple vehicles. Since the D-pad already allows players to cycle through camera distances and perspectives, I think remembering the last selected camera mode would be a simple quality-of-life improvement. An optional setting to always enter vehicles in first-person would also work. ### Additional context _No response_
